name: Priya Desai
household: Husband (55) and mother (80) living in joint family setup
psychographics: Balances traditional cooking values with modern fitness tracking. Treats health as a family responsibility, often preparing separate meals to meet her strict macro goals while respecting household norms.
current_solutions: Uses HealthifyMe app for calorie counting; buys roasted grams and millets from local 'Kirana' stores; follows a strict vegetarian 'clean eating' regimen.
frustration: At 9:00 AM on Thursday, the HealthifyMe app showed a 'network error' right as she was about to log her breakfast of idli and sambar, forcing her to estimate macros from memory and miss her protein goal by 15 grams.
decision_style: Consults family elders and reads health columns in local newspapers before trying new products; trusts brands with long-standing local presence over flashy imports.
voice: Formal yet warm, interspersed with Hindi phrases like 'achha' and 'theek hai'. Speaks slowly, prioritizing clarity over speed when discussing diet plans.
